criteria_results.text: Additive async-delegate path creates a parent-linked child, prompts it asynchronously, and returns an immediate dispatch acknowledgement without changing native task.
criteria_results.notes: Isolated live dispatch returned HTTP 202 in 43 ms with local and SDK child identifiers; the branch diff contains no native task.ts change.

criteria_results.text: The existing OpenCode event bridge detects the delegated child going idle after its assistant turn.
criteria_results.notes: The real child emitted CHILD_RECON_DONE and the parent received the callback through the existing stream bridge without child polling.

criteria_results.text: Child completion wakes an idle parent or queues behind a busy parent without clobbering ordering; concurrent completions are coalesced exactly once.
criteria_results.notes: Live smoke dispatched while the parent was working; USER_STEER_ACCEPTED arrived before PARENT_WAKE_RECON, and the durable callback appeared exactly once. Focused tests cover concurrent child coalescing and replay dedupe.

criteria_results.text: Async delegation is available only to interactive manager profiles and is denied to headless, scheduled, system, hidden, and non-manager paths.
criteria_results.notes: Runtime contract tests exercise system, scheduled, and hidden callers; projection tests force deny for ineligible profiles and full AgentRunner/scheduler regressions remained green.

criteria_results.text: The completion uses existing parent message and transcript surfaces so Flutter requires no bespoke renderer.
criteria_results.notes: The real callback entered the parent as a normal input and the answer streamed on existing message.part.delta/session.status frames.

criteria_results.text: Unit coverage plus a real sandbox E2E proves dispatch, child completion, and parent wake without polling.
criteria_results.notes: Manual Recon passed, then the codified live E2E passed in 6.31 seconds on branch-built API :4198 and fork :4197.

process_issues.description: The first codified live run asserted local database child IDs against /agent-sessions/:parent/children, which intentionally returns engine SDK sessions.
process_issues.detected_by: Vitest showed the real child with SDK id and parentID after the completion and exactly-once assertions had already passed; failure triage changed only the endpoint identity comparison.

process_issues.description: The first sandbox launch process was reaped when its command session exited even though sandbox.sh had emitted its ready line.
process_issues.detected_by: Both isolated ports were empty immediately after launch while api_server.log ended cleanly after readiness; holding the sandbox owner shell open kept ports 4197/4198 stable.

failure_output: First codified live run: expected /children to contain local id 46a965c3-... and parentSessionId 8af0b2ed-..., but the endpoint returned engine id ses_067ffb... with parentID ses_067ffb.... Behavior assertions before this lineage check passed.
suggested_follow_up: Live contracts crossing local and engine session surfaces should declare the identity domain of every endpoint before asserting lineage.
